name: spec
description: Full project lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis-architect → /spec:genesis-explore's fresh-UX-research candidate funnel and design pick → /spec:genesis-design ratifying the winner's tokens-as-code) → roadmap briefs with declared surfaces → per-brief /spec:sketch workbench (mock + brainstorm one brief, ratify before planning) → plan → mock-always design (local responsive HTML mocks under a render-critique harness covering the declared theme×viewport matrix; Claude Design demoted to escape hatch) → build → review → per-milestone /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas (the deterministic whole-product design view: journey graph, gap cards, annotation loop), with deterministic workflows, a hook-enforced state machine, per-repo grounding bootstrapped by /spec:init (activation-verified via its deliverable manifest; session grounding included — path-scoped rules, a generated permissions allowlist, run + verify skills), executed-boot and skipped-test gates behind every review verdict, deterministic rule enforcement generated by /spec:enforce, and a closed feedback loop: release flushes host findings into version-stamped briefs, the shipped intake ledger returns fixed-upstream signals through /spec:doctor, and /spec:status — the glanceable derived where-am-I view (roadmap/spec status + skip anomalies) behind one deterministic script shared with doctor and plan's dependency preflight (brief dependencies parsed item-wise, so spec references in a Depends-on header surface as anomalies instead of phantom blockers), and plan's lock step captures session-discovered follow-up work as roadmap briefs before context dies; /spec:review now reconciles the full unscoped diff against the File Plan via scope-reconcile.js — out-of-plan changes are a mechanical hard finding and get reviewed, planned-but-untouched files are a mechanical soft finding, and /spec:build's Final gate surfaces the same signal advisory
